diagnostic_recommendations_for_chronic_H: Routine blood tests for comorbidities including full blood count, urea and electrolytes, thyroid function, fasting glucose and HbA1c, lipids, iron studies (TSAT and ferritin)

Cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) for assessment of myocardial structure and function in patients with poor echocardiographic windows and for tissue characterisation where infiltrative disease is suspected (eg, Fabry disease, amyloid, sarcoidosis, iron overload/haemochromatosis)
Invasive coronary angiography recommended in patients with angina despite pharmacological therapy or symptomatic ventricular arrhythmias
Cardiopulmonary exercise testing as part of evaluation for heart transplantation and/or mechanical circulatory support (MCS)
Right heart catheterization recommended in patients with severe HF being evaluated for heart transplantation or MCS
treatment_recommendations_for_HFrEF: ACE inhibitors recommended to reduce risk of HF hospitalization and death (class I)
Beta-blockers recommended to reduce risk of HF hospitalization and death (class I)
Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRA) recommended to reduce risk of HF hospitalization and death (class I)
SGLT2 inhibitors (dapagliflozin or empagliflozin) recommended for patients with HFrEF to reduce risk of HF hospitalization and death (class I)
Sacubitril/valsartan (ARNI) recommended as a replacement for an ACE inhibitor in patients with HFrEF to reduce risk of HF hospitalization and death
Diuretics recommended in patients with HFrEF with signs and/or symptoms of congestion to alleviate symptoms and improve exercise capacity
An ARB recommended for patients unable to tolerate an ACE inhibitor

Implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) recommended to reduce risk of sudden death and all-cause mortality in selected patients (eg, post-MI with persistent reduced LVEF and adequate life expectancy)
Cardiac resynchronisation therapy (CRT) recommended for symptomatic patients in sinus rhythm with QRS duration ≥150 ms with LBBB morphology and LVEF ≤35% despite optimal medical therapy
CRT not recommended in patients with QRS duration <130 ms who do not have indication for pacing
treatment_recommendations_for_HFmrEF_and: Diuretics recommended in patients with congestion and HFmrEF/HFpEF to alleviate symptoms and signs
